chunks: When Adam عليه السلام departed from Mina, the angels met him at al-Abtah and said: O Adam, may your hajj be accepted; indeed, we performed hajj to this House two thousand years before you performed hajj to it.

key_terms.أَفَاضَ: departed and moved on from a pilgrimage station
key_terms.الْأَبْطَحِ: al-Abtah, the place where the angels received him
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who met Adam عليه السلام
key_terms.حَجُّكَ: your hajj, referring to Adam’s pilgrimage
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the well-known sacred location in the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the angels performing hajj before Adam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts that after Adam عليه السلام departed from Mina, the angels greeted him and acknowledged his hajj. It indicates the ancient sanctity of the Sacred House and presents hajj as a worship rooted deep in sacred history, even before the earthly pilgrimage of Adam عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2275 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"When Adam (as) descended from Mina, the angels met him at Al-Abtah and said, 'O Adam, may your pilgrimage be accepted. Indeed, we performed pilgrimage to this House two thousand years before you.'"
